Definition: Structured wrapper returned for nontrivial outputs and required for job/validation outputs at the boundary.
Boundary type for mutating operations.
Boundary type for read-only operations.
Boundary type for long-running solve, export, and report work.
Identifies target-family metadata, validation posture, no-bypass controls, and unresolved TBD decisions.
Preserves canonical model identity when a target cannot carry canonical IDs directly.
Records exported, omitted, approximated, unsupported, or delegated behavior to expose target limitations.
Optional, user-owned, hash/provenance-bound evidence for regression or handoff review.
Export preserving result status, units, diagnostics, provenance, hashes, and professional-boundary notices without protected rule content.
PCF export using explicit target limitations, stable ID mapping, and loss reporting without hidden translator defaults.
Visual review context only; not solver, FEA, validation, or acceptance geometry.
Surfaces exposing manifests, target registries, validation checklists, diagnostics, and no-bypass constraints.
Mediating layer through which persistence and boundary effects must be routed.
Constrained evaluator that prevents arbitrary code execution through rule packs.
Packaged user rules with name/ID, version, checksum, source note, public/private marking, and redistribution status.
Diagnostic returned when protected or proprietary content is suspected and the payload is blocked or quarantined.
Software-emitted status value distinct from hash-bound human acceptance records (e.g. MECHANICS_SOLVED, USER_RULE_CHECKED).
Recorded origin/history metadata required on validation outputs and boundary payloads.
Canonicalization basis for hashing JSON payloads.
Denied-by-default concept-level boundary tokens requested by plugin manifest or boundary request.
